metadata.description: Claude Code plan usage and named-login switching, in any MCP client: the usage-panel plugin from claude-usage-panel.

plugins.name: usage-panel
plugins.description: Ask Claude for your plan usage and switch accounts in-conversation: get_usage returns session, weekly, and per-model limits from the official Anthropic usage endpoint; waiting lists live sessions blocked on a permission prompt, a question, or idle after Stop; list_accounts / save_account / switch_account / rename_account manage named Claude Code logins (PRO, PERSO) without a browser.

plugins.name: usage-footer
plugins.description: The line under the Claude Code prompt, drawn by a mod: model, project, branch and agents on the left; context and plan-limit gauges (session, week) flush right, with the clock tick, a burn-rate warning, and a toast at 90% / 100%. Opt-in; ./install.sh footer replaces the status line with it.
